# spec._compile.compile { #fmrimod.spec._compile.compile }

```python
compile(
    spec,
    data,
    sampling_frame,
    *,
    block=None,
    durations=None,
    precision=None,
)
```

Lower a Spec or single Term to ``(EventModel, BaselineModel)``.

The low-level lowering step. For a named design matrix use
``fmrimod.design_matrix(spec, events=..., n_scans=..., tr=...)``; to fit,
pass the spec to `fmrimod.fmri_lm`.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type          | Description                                                                                                                 | Default    |
|----------------|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| spec           | Spec \| Term  | Typed spec (``hrf(...) + drift(...)``) or a single term.                                                                    | _required_ |
| data           | pd.DataFrame  | Events table (``onset``, ``duration``, condition columns, ``run``).                                                         | _required_ |
| sampling_frame | SamplingFrame | `SamplingFrame` giving run lengths and TR.                                                         | _required_ |
| block          | object        | Run labels (column name or array), event durations (column name, scalar or array) and HRF convolution precision in seconds. | `None`     |
| durations      | object        | Run labels (column name or array), event durations (column name, scalar or array) and HRF convolution precision in seconds. | `None`     |
| precision      | object        | Run labels (column name or array), event durations (column name, scalar or array) and HRF convolution precision in seconds. | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                    |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | tuple  | ``(EventModel \| None, BaselineModel)``; the event model is ``None`` for a baseline-only spec. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> import pandas as pd
>>> from fmrimod import SamplingFrame
>>> from fmrimod.spec import drift, hrf
>>> events = pd.DataFrame({"onset": [4.0, 20.0], "duration": 1.0,
...                        "trial_type": ["a", "b"]})
>>> em, bm = compile(hrf("trial_type") + drift(), events,
...                  SamplingFrame(blocklens=40, TR=2.0))
>>> em.design_matrix.shape, len(bm.column_names)
((40, 2), 2)
```
